thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired (P1) — SERVICE: auth-service-prod — ALERT: token-signing-errors spike — incident_id=inc-20260315-01 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Symptoms: elevated 5xx from /v1/auth/validate, downstream 401s, spike in "kid" mismatch logs, threshold breached (5m)
oncall-mike: Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — pinging auth owners @alex_auth @sara_ops :white_check_mark:
oncall-mike: Quick check — are we seeing key rotation events in the last 10m?
alex_auth: seeing repeated logs: `invalid_jwt: kid not found: kid=key_2026_03_15_08` and a few `signature verification failed` from the signing service. No explicit rotate job scheduled in the last hour.
sara_ops: Confirmed. Metrics: auth-validate errors from us-west-2 jumped to 42% error rate at 08:41 UTC. Affected routes: /v1/auth/validate, /v1/token/refresh.
jess_prodsec: tagging possible customer impact. Any high-traffic tenants? @luis_support can you surface any major customer reports?
luis_support: So far three support tickets from EU tenants reporting login failures. No public incident yet.
oncall-mike: Reproducing locally against staging token verifier with current JWKS shows missing kid when calling `/keys/latest` — looks like propagation delay or stale cache.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation step 1 — paging SRE lead and Backup oncall
alex_auth: I’m going to check the JWKS store and the signing service. Running: `kubectl -n auth logs deploy/auth-signing -c signer --since=15m | grep kid`
alex_auth: got it — signer emitted key rotate event at 08:40:12 UTC with new kid=key_2026_03_15_08, but jwks-service shows cached keys without that kid on some replicas. Suspect JWKS cache invalidation problem.
sara_ops: Rolling a quick diagnostic: `curl -s https://jwks.prod.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'` — some zones still show old kids only.
oncall-mike: Probable root cause: signing service rotated key, but JWKS cache TTL and multi-region propagation caused mismatch. Mitigation plan?
alex_auth: Two short-term options: 1) Rollback rotation to previous key (requires signer rollback), 2) Force JWKS cache flush across replicas (restart jwks pods) and push cache-bust header. Option 2 is less disruptive if it completes quickly.
jess_prodsec: Priority: minimize customer auth failures. Option 2 preferred. Prepare for option 1 if option 2 doesn't converge in 5m.
sara_ops: I'm going to restart jwks-service pods in US/EU. Will do rolling restarts to avoid full outage.
sara_ops: `kubectl -n auth rollout restart deployment/jwks-service --timeout=120s` executed in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 :rocket:
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/jwks-service (us-west-2) — rev 42 -> 43
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/jwks-service (eu-west-1) — rev 19 -> 20
alex_auth: Meanwhile, adding a short grace window: updating token-verifier to accept previous kid for 2 minutes by toggling feature flag `auth.allow_previous_kid=true` via config service. Pushing now.
oncall-mike: Config flip applied. Monitoring error rate.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: ack recorded by oncall-mike at 08:46 UTC — incident status: acknowledged
sara_ops: US and EU replicas restarted; JWKS payload now includes key_2026_03_15_08 on all pods I can query. Confirming with curl.
luis_support: Support tickets seeing successful re-login after ~30-90s. Customers being notified via private channel.
alex_auth: Error rate dropped from 42% -> 3% in 3 minutes. Logs show fewer `kid not found`.
jess_prodsec: Good. Keep monitoring for 15m. Mike, please prepare a short incident summary for handoff to oncall next shift.
oncall-mike: Will do. I'm going to keep monitoring and set automated alert thresholds back down.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: no further escalation required. If error rate creeps >5% again, page SRE lead.
sara_ops: Leaving breadcrumbs: created a short runbook note in Confluence `auth/jwks-rotation-propagation` with steps taken and follow-ups.
alex_auth: Follow-ups: add a cache-invalidation hook in the signer service to POST to jwks-service on rotate, and add cross-region propagation test in CI.
luis_support: Noted. Will send a message to affected customers with summary and ETA for RCA.
oncall-mike: Handoff: I'm toggling maintenance window on PagerDuty for auth-service for 1 hour while we run additional checks.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: maintenance mode enabled for SERVICE: auth-service-prod by oncall-mike
jen: (system) — placeholder user not part of participants, ignore
jess_prodsec: Thanks team. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign owners for follow-ups: cache-hook (alex), CI test (sara), support comms (luis), config hardening (mike).
oncall-mike: Last check: error rate stable at 1.8%. I'll mark this thread monitored. If anyone sees regression ping here. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident inc-20260315-01 status: mitigated — root cause: JWKS propagation delay after key rotation causing temporary JWT kid mismatch; mitigation: JWKS pod restarts + config grace window; next step: RCA and permanent fix
sara_ops: Thanks all. Filing the on-call note and adding timeline to the incident doc.
alex_auth: After-action note: we will also add alert for simultaneous rotate+cache TTL mismatch.
luis_support: Sent customer update. Closing tickets as fixed pending customer confirm.
noncall-mike: Ending handoff — off to sync with next oncall at shift change.
incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents channel history at 09:04 UTC
